description: Prompt-eval cohorts for the issue-#236 paraphrase/cross-language contract (issue #270). Each group runs as one live recovery call. Retained cases pair a corpus reference statement with a verbatim dossier excerpt from run 6e82a760755b66a5 (judge 2026-09-06.9, inception/mercury-2.5-preview); the excerpt stands in for its claim, so the gate is decided-vs-parked, not exact-verdict replay. Control cases are synthetic and labeled as such.

groups.why: English reference statements against Swedish dossier claims: the judge must decide across the language gap, never park on it.

references.statement: Anders Danielsson took office as president and chief executive of Skanska on 1 January 2018.
Before becoming chief executive he was deputy chief executive responsible for Skanska's construction units in the United States and for its infrastructure development.
He was employed at Skanska in 1991 after graduating from the KTH Royal Institute of Technology.
He became head of Skanska's Swedish business in 2008 and joined group management in 2013 with responsibility for the Nordics, the United Kingdom and the United States.
He has been chief executive of Skanska Norge and Skanska Sverige as well as deputy chief executive of Skanska AB.
Svenska Dagbladet's 2017 report on his appointment was headlined on his strong profitability focus, and a companion piece asked how Skanska would come through the crisis.

references.statement: Sally Kornbluth became the 18th president of MIT in January 2023.
She was provost of Duke University from 1 July 2014 to 31 December 2022.
Her research concerns cell growth and programmed cell death, including how cancer cells evade apoptosis and the role of caspase-2 in regulating the length of female fertility in vertebrates.

claims.statement: Sally Kornbluth is the 18th President of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology since January 2023.
She served as provost of Duke University from July 2014 to December 2022.
Her research focuses on cell growth and programmed cell death and how cancer cells evade apoptosis.

groups.why: Heavier paraphrases: renamed institutions, reframed roles, and claims that add context beyond the reference.

references.statement: Kristalina Georgieva has served as the 12th Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund since 1 October 2019, the first person from an emerging market economy to lead the institution.

She was Chief Executive of the World Bank Group from 2 January 2017 to 1 October 2019, a post established for her and abolished afterwards, and acting President of the World Bank Group from 1 February to 8 April 2019.
As European Commissioner for Budget and Human Resources from 1 November 2014 to 31 December 2016 she managed the EU's budget and staff through the aftermath of the Eurozone debt crisis.
Her BA, MA and PhD are all from the University of National and World Economy in Sofia.

claims.statement: Georgieva has served as the 12th managing director of the International Monetary Fund since 1 October 2019.
Georgieva served as the first chief executive officer of the World Bank from 2 January 2017 to 1 October 2019.
She managed the EU's budget and staff through the aftermath of the Eurozone debt crisis and during the 2015 refugee crisis.
Georgieva holds a PhD in economics and an MA in Political Economy and Sociology from the Karl Marx Higher Institute of Economics (now called University of National and World Economy) in Sofia.
